description: GeoMOP is the spatial data infrastructure portal of the Chilean Ministry of Public Works. It offers viewers for emergencies and the operating status of MOP infrastructure and for public and commissioned buildings, and it says users can find public works projects and contracts funded or commissioned by the ministry; inventories of infrastructure for roads, ports, hydraulic works, airports, architecture, water and concessions; and damage to MOP infrastructure caused by emergencies. A download section offers the IDEMOP territorial information, and the portal lists its viewers, layers and map services, some of which are for internal use. Access to the public viewers and downloads is free; no licence is stated on the page read, and questions go to the ministry's citizen service. Caveats: the portal is in Spanish, and some layers are internal only. Coverage is Chile. It supports multi-sector infrastructure asset mapping, hazard exposure and emergency response analysis, such as damage to roads, bridges and water works after earthquakes, floods and fires; related records are the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos and OpenCUP of Italy.
